title: Regional and Temporal Dynamics of Dengue in Mexico (2020-2024): A Comprehensive Epidemiological Analysis.
abstract: Dengue remains a major public health concern in Mexico, with incidence and clinical burden increasing substantially in recent years. Using national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the changing epidemiological landscape, with an emphasis on geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. Over this period, Mexico saw an almost fivefold increase in dengue cases, reaching over 123,000 confirmed infections and 426 deaths in 2024, the highest annual number recorded. Seasonal patterns shifted, with sustained transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. Serotyping data revealed a shift in predominant virus serotypes, with DENV2 predominating until 2022, DENV1 peaking in 2021, and DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward, becoming dominant in 2023 and almost exclusive by 2024. This shift coincided with a sustained rise in dengue with warning signs (from 16.9% in 2020 to > 42% in 2023-2024) and higher hospitalisation rates, while severe dengue remained below 5%. Although DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically, particularly in southern and northern regions. Several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, underscoring the potential for sudden epidemic expansion. Climatic analysis showed a consistent positive association between temperature and DENV3 prevalence, with precipitation effects varying by year. Odds ratio analysis suggested serotype-specific differences in severity across years. These findings underscore the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico and highlight the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies.

abstract_zh: 登革热仍然是墨西哥的主要公共卫生问题,近年来其流行程度和临床负担显著增加。本研究利用2020年至2024年的全国登革热数据,全面概述了登革热流行病学景观的变化,重点分析了地理分布、时间趋势、血清型动态以及疾病严重程度。在这一时期,墨西哥的登革热病例数几乎增加了五倍,2024年达到超过123,000例确诊病例和426例死亡,这是有记录以来最高的年度病例数。季节性模式发生了变化,持续的登革热传播从2023年底延伸到了不寻常的冬季月份。血清型数据揭示了主要病毒血清型的变化,DENV2在2022年之前占主导地位,DENV1在2021年达到高峰,而DENV3则从2022年开始急剧上升,成为2023年的主导血清型,并在2024年几乎成为唯一流行的血清型。这种变化与登革热病例数的持续上升以及警告信号的增加(从2020年的16.9%上升到2023-2024年的>42%)相吻合,同时医院入院率也显著提高,而重症登革热病例仍低于5%。尽管DENV3在全国范围内占主导地位,但DENV1和DENV2在某些州仍持续存在,而DENV4则在南部和北部地区偶有流行。一些传统上登革热流行率较低的州出现了非典型的流行模式,突显了登革热暴发可能突然扩展的潜在风险。气候分析显示,温度与DENV3的流行率之间存在一致的正相关关系,而降水的影响则因年份而异。比值比分析表明,不同血清型在不同年份的严重程度存在差异。这些发现突显了墨西哥登革热传播模式的异质性和动态性,并强调了制定区域性监测、预防和临床准备策略的必要性。

title: Interacting climatic, environmental, biologic and socio-economic drivers of the global dengue expansion.
abstract: Abstract Dengue is the most rapidly expanding mosquito‐borne viral disease worldwide. The worst year on record was 2024, with over 100 countries reporting 14.4 million cases and over 11,000 deaths. Since then, and up to August 2026, another 7.4 million cases and over 5000 deaths have been reported. The region of the Americas was impacted the most, followed by South‐East Asia and the Western Pacific. Both the spread of dengue viruses (DENV) and their primary vectors, Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus , are driven by several factors. Globalization has accelerated vector dispersal, particularly through international trade and transportation networks. The movement of desiccation‐resistant eggs in used‐vehicle tyres and the inadvertent transport of adult mosquitoes via trucks and passenger vehicles have enabled the establishment of vector populations in previously uncolonized regions. Human mobility and unplanned urbanization further contribute to dengue emergence by introducing DENV into susceptible populations where competent vectors circulate. Climate change has enhanced dengue transmission potential by altering temperature and rainfall patterns that influence mosquito survival, reproduction, biting behaviour and viral replication. Containing or even reversing this global dengue expansion will require a complementary set of interventions that rely on proven and novel control strategies, including sterile insect techniques, Wolbachia‐ infected mosquitoes, virus‐resistant mosquito strains through CRISPR‐Cas9 gene drive, vaccines, antiviral drug prophylaxis and urban interventions that eliminate Aedes habitats. Building climate‐resilient urban environments through sustainable development to minimize the urban heat island effect and advancing climate‐informed early warning systems are long‐term strategies for effective dengue control.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue is the most rapidly expanding mosquito‐borne viral disease worldwide. The study aimed to understand the factors driving this expansion.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed global dengue expansion trends, focusing on the region of the Americas, South‐East Asia, and the Western Pacific. It reported data up to August 2026, including 14.4 million cases and over 11,000 deaths in 2024.
analysis.methods: The study examined the spread of dengue viruses (DENV) and their vectors, Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, through factors like globalization, human mobility, and climate change. It highlighted the role of international trade and transportation networks in vector dispersal.
analysis.main_results: Since 2024, another 7.4 million cases and over 5000 deaths have been reported globally, with the Americas being the most impacted region.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that containing or reversing dengue expansion requires a combination of proven and novel control strategies, including vaccines, antiviral drugs, and urban interventions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the development of climate‐informed early warning systems and sustainable urban development to minimize dengue transmission risks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on reported data and does not provide detailed statistical analyses or experimental validation, which limits the confidence in its conclusions. The evidence is moderate in strength.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the global expansion of dengue, highlighting its rapid spread since 2024 with over 14.4 million cases and 11,000 deaths. It identifies key drivers such as globalization, human mobility, and climate change, emphasizing the need for integrated control strategies. The findings suggest that climate‐informed early warning systems and sustainable urban development are critical for dengue prevention. However, the study lacks detailed statistical analyses and experimental validation, limiting the confidence in its conclusions.

title_zh: 全球登革热扩张的相互作用的气候、环境、生物和社会经济驱动因素。
source_body_en: Abstract Dengue is the most rapidly expanding mosquito‐borne viral disease worldwide. The worst year on record was 2024, with over 100 countries reporting 14.4 million cases and over 11,000 deaths. Since then, and up to August 2026, another 7.4 million cases and over 5000 deaths have been reported. The region of the Americas was impacted the most, followed by South‐East Asia and the Western Pacific. Both the spread of dengue viruses (DENV) and their primary vectors, Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus , are driven by several factors. Globalization has accelerated vector dispersal, particularly through international trade and transportation networks. The movement of desiccation‐resistant eggs in used‐vehicle tyres and the inadvertent transport of adult mosquitoes via trucks and passenger vehicles have enabled the establishment of vector populations in previously uncolonized regions. Human mobility and unplanned urbanization further contribute to dengue emergence by introducing DENV into susceptible populations where competent vectors circulate. Climate change has enhanced dengue transmission potential by altering temperature and rainfall patterns that influence mosquito survival, reproduction, biting behaviour and viral replication. Containing or even reversing this global dengue expansion will require a complementary set of interventions that rely on proven and novel control strategies, including sterile insect techniques, Wolbachia‐ infected mosquitoes, virus‐resistant mosquito strains through CRISPR‐Cas9 gene drive, vaccines, antiviral drug prophylaxis and urban interventions that eliminate Aedes habitats. Building climate‐resilient urban environments through sustainable development to minimize the urban heat island effect and advancing climate‐informed early warning systems are long‐term strategies for effective dengue control.

title: Reconstructing Dengue Exposure Dynamics and Assessing the Public Health Impact of Vaccination Scenarios Using Mathematical Models in Brazil
abstract: Abstract Brazil experienced its worst dengue epidemic in 2024, with an increase in severe outcomes among elderly individuals, highlighting the need for vaccination strategies informed by population immunity. We reconstructed state- and age-specific immune profiles by fitting an age-structured catalytic model to dengue surveillance data from 2000–2025. This inferred immune profile was incorporated into an SIR-type transmission model to project disease burden and to evaluate the public health impact of vaccine allocation strategies. We observed substantial spatial heterogeneity in accumulated immunity, which was closely associated with projected burden and optimal allocation. Strategies prioritizing states with lower historical incidence and larger susceptible populations yielded greater benefits. Under limited vaccine supply, targeting children resulted in the greatest reductions in DALYs, whereas targeting elderly populations achieved smaller DALY reductions but larger reductions in mortality. We further showed that accelerated vaccine supply markedly increased impact, while allocation choices remained critical when availability was constrained.

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The research involved reconstructing state- and age-specific immune profiles using dengue surveillance data from 2000 to 2025, focusing on Brazil's population dynamics and disease burden.
analysis_en.methods: An age-structured catalytic model was fitted to dengue surveillance data to infer immune profiles, which were then integrated into an SIR-type transmission model to project disease burden and assess vaccine allocation strategies.
analysis_en.main_results: The study found substantial spatial heterogeneity in accumulated immunity, which was closely linked to projected disease burden and the effectiveness of vaccine allocation strategies.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that strategies prioritizing states with lower historical incidence and larger susceptible populations provided greater public health benefits, offering a novel approach to vaccine distribution.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted vaccination strategies in Brazil, particularly in regions with lower immunity and higher susceptibility, to reduce disease burden and mortality effectively.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's results are based on modeled data, which may introduce uncertainties, and the evidence is moderate due to the reliance on historical surveillance data rather than direct experimental measurements.

title_zh: 在巴西使用数学模型重建登革热暴露动态并评估 疫苗接种 情景的公共卫生影响
source_body_en: Abstract Brazil experienced its worst dengue epidemic in 2024, with an increase in severe outcomes among elderly individuals, highlighting the need for vaccination strategies informed by population immunity. We reconstructed state- and age-specific immune profiles by fitting an age-structured catalytic model to dengue surveillance data from 2000–2025. This inferred immune profile was incorporated into an SIR-type transmission model to project disease burden and to evaluate the public health impact of vaccine allocation strategies. We observed substantial spatial heterogeneity in accumulated immunity, which was closely associated with projected burden and optimal allocation. Strategies prioritizing states with lower historical incidence and larger susceptible populations yielded greater benefits. Under limited vaccine supply, targeting children resulted in the greatest reductions in DALYs, whereas targeting elderly populations achieved smaller DALY reductions but larger reductions in mortality. We further showed that accelerated vaccine supply markedly increased impact, while allocation choices remained critical when availability was constrained.
abstract_zh: 摘要 巴西在 2024 年经历了最严重的登革热疫情,老年人中严重后果的增加,凸显了基于人群免疫力的 疫苗接种 策略的必要性。我们通过将年龄结构的催化模型与 2000 年至 2025 年的登革热 监测 数据进行拟合,重建了州和年龄特异性的免疫特征。这种推断的免疫特征被纳入 SIR 型 传播 模型中,以预测疾病负担并评估 疫苗 分配策略对公共卫生的影响。我们观察到累积免疫力存在显着的空间异质性,这与预计的负担和最佳分配密切相关。优先考虑历史 发病率 较低和易感人群较多的州的策略产生了更大的效益。在 疫苗 供应有限的情况下,针对儿童的 DALY 降低幅度最大,而针对老年人群的 DALY 降低幅度较小,但 死亡率 的降低幅度较大。我们进一步表明,加速的 疫苗 供应显着增加了影响,而当可用性受到限制时,分配选择仍然至关重要。

title: Platelet Indices as Biomarkers of Disease Severity and Morbidity in Hospitalized Dengue Patients.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is a rapidly expanding mosquito-borne illness with significant morbidity in children. While thrombocytopenia is a key feature, platelet count alone poorly predicts disease severity. Platelet indices such as mean platelet volume (MPV), platelet distribution width (PDW), and plateletcrit (PCT) may provide better insight into disease progression and complications. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This hospital-based cross-sectional observational study was conducted in the Department of Pediatrics, at a tertiary care hospital over 18 months. A total of 120 children aged 1-16 years with confirmed dengue infection (NS1 antigen or immunoglobulin M positive) were enrolled. Platelet indices were recorded at admission. Patients were classified according to the World Health Organization 2009 dengue severity criteria. Associations between platelet indices and disease severity, hepatic dysfunction, and renal dysfunction were analyzed using appropriate statistical tests. RESULTS: Among 120 patients, 35% had dengue without warning signs, 48.3% had warning signs, and 16.7% had severe dengue. MPV and PCT decreased, while PDW increased significantly with disease severity (P < 0.001). Hepatic (31.7%) and renal (9.2%) dysfunction were associated with lower MPV and PCT and higher PDW (P < 0.001). PDW showed a strong positive correlation with severity (r = 0.71), whereas MPV and PCT showed negative correlations. CONCLUSION: Platelet indices, particularly PDW and PCT, are simple, readily available, and reliable markers for predicting disease severity and organ dysfunction in pediatric dengue. Their routine use may aid early risk stratification, timely intervention, and improved clinical decision-making, especially in resource-limited settings where advanced biomarkers may not be accessible.

title: Bacterial immune priming and Wolbachia-mediated dengue blocking in Aedes albopictus mosquitoes.
abstract: Background Wolbachia is a maternally-transmitted bacterial endosymbiont that is highly prevalent amongst arthropods. Many Wolbachia strains induce pathogen blocking, thereby protecting their hosts from pathogenic microbial infections. Blocking against pathogenic bacteria occurs in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, where Wolbachia has been artificially established by microinjection. However, in Drosophila fruit flies, it occurs after oral bacterial challenge but not after systemic challenge via injection. Pathogen blocking has been linked to increased host immune activity associated with Wolbachia infection. This is similar in principle to immune priming, a memory immune response in insects, where sub-lethal exposure to a pathogen increases the ability to survive future infections. Aedes albopictus mosquitoes naturally harbor Wolbachia ; however, the extent to which native Wolbachia -mediated pathogen blocking and immune priming influence host response to infection remains unclear. Accordingly, we sought to characterize the response of Wolbachia -infected Ae. albopictus to bacterial challenge, and to determine whether the combination of these microbes could hinder a subsequent infection with dengue virus. Methodology/principal findings We challenged adult female Ae. albopictus with and without their native Wolbachia infection with a sub-lethal dose of four mosquito-associated bacteria: Micrococcus, Staphylococcus (gram positive), Brevundimonas , Enterobacter (gram negative). Assessing post-challenge mortality, we observed that Wolbachia infection reduced cumulative mortality and delayed the onset of senescence amongst mosquitoes challenged with each bacterium. However, this protective effect was stronger against gram positive bacteria. albopictus were then orally challenged with DENV. We observed that mosquitoes that experienced a pre-challenge with gram negative bacteria were associated with reduced DENV prevalence and viral load, whereas Wolbachia -infected mosquitoes exhibited further reductions in viral load. Conclusions/significance We highlight novel characteristics of native Wolbachia infection in Ae. albopictus mosquitoes, with protection against bacterial-induced mortality, and interactions between pathogen blocking and bacterial priming that may depend on bacterial gram status. These findings provide insight into the immune interactions associated with native Wolbachia and build on our understanding of adaptive immunity in mosquitoes.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how native Wolbachia infection in Aedes albopictus mosquitoes influences their response to bacterial challenges and whether this interaction could impact subsequent dengue virus infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved challenging adult female Aedes albopictus mosquitoes with and without their native Wolbachia infection using sub-lethal doses of four mosquito-associated bacteria and then orally challenging them with dengue virus.

title_zh: 白纹伊蚊的细菌免疫启动和沃尔巴克氏体介导的登革热阻断。
source_body_en: Background Wolbachia is a maternally-transmitted bacterial endosymbiont that is highly prevalent amongst arthropods. Many Wolbachia strains induce pathogen blocking, thereby protecting their hosts from pathogenic microbial infections. Blocking against pathogenic bacteria occurs in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, where Wolbachia has been artificially established by microinjection. However, in Drosophila fruit flies, it occurs after oral bacterial challenge but not after systemic challenge via injection. Pathogen blocking has been linked to increased host immune activity associated with Wolbachia infection. This is similar in principle to immune priming, a memory immune response in insects, where sub-lethal exposure to a pathogen increases the ability to survive future infections. Aedes albopictus mosquitoes naturally harbor Wolbachia ; however, the extent to which native Wolbachia -mediated pathogen blocking and immune priming influence host response to infection remains unclear. Accordingly, we sought to characterize the response of Wolbachia -infected Ae. albopictus to bacterial challenge, and to determine whether the combination of these microbes could hinder a subsequent infection with dengue virus. Methodology/principal findings We challenged adult female Ae. albopictus with and without their native Wolbachia infection with a sub-lethal dose of four mosquito-associated bacteria: Micrococcus, Staphylococcus (gram positive), Brevundimonas , Enterobacter (gram negative). Assessing post-challenge mortality, we observed that Wolbachia infection reduced cumulative mortality and delayed the onset of senescence amongst mosquitoes challenged with each bacterium. However, this protective effect was stronger against gram positive bacteria. albopictus were then orally challenged with DENV. We observed that mosquitoes that experienced a pre-challenge with gram negative bacteria were associated with reduced DENV prevalence and viral load, whereas Wolbachia -infected mosquitoes exhibited further reductions in viral load. Conclusions/significance We highlight novel characteristics of native Wolbachia infection in Ae. albopictus mosquitoes, with protection against bacterial-induced mortality, and interactions between pathogen blocking and bacterial priming that may depend on bacterial gram status. These findings provide insight into the immune interactions associated with native Wolbachia and build on our understanding of adaptive immunity in mosquitoes.
abstract_zh: 背景沃尔巴克氏体是一种母源传播的细菌内共生体,在节肢动物中非常普遍。许多沃尔巴克氏体菌株诱导病原体阻断,从而保护其 宿主 免受病原微生物感染。对埃及伊蚊的病原菌的阻断发生在埃及伊蚊中,其中沃尔巴克氏体是通过显微注射人工建立的。然而,在果蝇中,它发生在口服细菌攻击后,而不是在通过注射进行全身攻击后。病原体阻断与沃尔巴克氏体感染相关的 宿主 免疫活性增加有关。这在原理上类似于免疫启动,即昆虫的记忆 免疫应答,其中亚致死暴露于病原体会增加在未来感染中生存的能力。白纹伊蚊天然携带沃尔巴克氏体;然而,天然沃尔巴克氏体介导的病原体阻断和免疫启动在多大程度上影响 宿主 对感染的反应仍不清楚。因此,我们试图描述感染沃尔巴克氏体的伊蚊的反应特征。白纹伊蚊进行细菌攻击,并确定这些微生物的组合是否可以阻碍 登革病毒 的后续感染。方法/主要发现 我们对成年女性 Ae 提出了挑战。白纹伊蚊感染或不感染原生沃尔巴克氏体,感染亚致死剂量的四种与蚊子相关的细菌:微球菌、葡萄球菌(革兰氏阳性)、短波单胞菌、肠杆菌(革兰氏阴性)。评估攻击后 死亡率,我们观察到沃尔巴克氏体感染减少了累积的 死亡率 并延迟了用每种细菌攻击的蚊子的衰老开始。然而,这种保护作用对革兰氏阳性菌更强。然后对白纹伊蚊进行口服 DENV 攻击。我们观察到,经历过革兰氏阴性细菌预攻击的蚊子与 DENV 患病率 和病毒载量减少有关,而感染沃尔巴克氏体的蚊子则表现出病毒载量进一步减少。结论/意义 我们强调了伊蚊本地沃尔巴克氏体感染的新特征。白纹伊蚊,具有针对细菌诱导的 死亡率 的保护,以及病原体阻断和细菌引发之间的相互作用,这可能取决于细菌革兰氏状态。这些发现提供了对与本土沃尔巴克氏体相关的免疫相互作用的深入了解,并建立在我们对蚊子适应性免疫的理解之上。

title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

abstract_zh: 蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV))构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特异性抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的医疗需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的显著下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白质加工一致。分子对接分析支持这些发现,预测这些化合物与关键病毒酶(特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶)具有有利的相互作用。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其具有跨虫媒病毒的疗效。综上所述,这些发现表明螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在从植物来源的天然产物中鉴定新型抗病毒药物化合物,以应对针对蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV))的特异性抗病毒药物疗法的未满足需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过功能实验评估提取物的抗病毒药物活性,从而分离并表征四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷。
analysis_zh.main_results: 五种提取物显著降低了DENV-2的感染性,在非细胞毒性浓度下,Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.实现了完全抑制。分离出的化合物抑制了DENV的复制,这表现在病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的明显下降。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果确定了螺甾烷皂苷作为有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物,对ZIKV和CHIKV具有跨属病毒的疗效。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于开发针对登革热和其他虫媒病毒的新抗病毒药物疗法,从而潜在地减少这些感染对全球公共卫生的负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用非随机的体外方法,这可能限制其结果的普遍适用性。由于研究结果尚处于初步阶段,证据强度中等。

title: Computational Insights Into the Conformational Dynamics of the Dengue Virus Capsid Protein.
abstract: The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. title_zh: 对 登革病毒 衣壳蛋白构象动力学的计算见解。
source_body_en: The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 衣壳蛋白在病毒生命周期中发挥重要作用,包括 基因组 的衣壳化、脂滴的招募和颗粒的组装。衣壳蛋白包含一个疏水口袋,它在这些功能以及闭合和开放构象之间的转换中发挥着核心作用。这项工作研究了衣壳蛋白的构象变化途径,特别是如何控制控制疏水袋打开和关闭的分子机制。通过结合使用不同类型的分子动力学模拟和增强的采样方法,我们分享了对在控制这些转变中发挥关键作用的结构重排的见解。我们的结果表明,脂质结合通过环境因素调节疏水袋的可及性。在开放构象中,口袋参与与脂质的相互作用、衣壳二聚体的稳定以及促进未成熟病毒的组装。相反,闭合构象可以保护疏水袋免受周围水介质的影响,同时还可以防止溶液相中过早的相互作用,从而破坏蛋白质的稳定性。这些见解使人们能够深入了解衣壳蛋白的构象动力学,并为旨在干扰其功能转变的 抗病毒药物 策略提供了一组有前景的有效靶标。

title: New Perspectives in Prevention, Control, and Treatment of Dengue Fever
abstract: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease primarily transmitted by Aedes aegypti and is endemic in tropical and subtropical regions worldwide. It represents a major global public health challenge because of its rapid expansion and increasing incidence. Clinical manifestations range from mild febrile illness to severe disease with hemorrhage and death. No specific antiviral treatment exists, and prevention has relied on vector control to reduce human–mosquito contact. Although vaccines are available, access remains limited. In the Americas, dengue transmission has intensified markedly in recent years. The largest epidemic occurred in 2024, with more than 12.6 million cases and over 7700 deaths. In 2025, reports showed 4 million suspected cases, including 8966 severe cases and 2207 deaths. This persistent burden may be driven by climate variability, urbanization, mobility, environmental change, and widespread vector distribution, all of which contribute to ongoing transmission and disease severity. These trends underscore the critical need to strengthen surveillance, improve integrated vector management, expand vaccine access, and develop effective therapies to reduce the health, social, and economic impact of this disease. Accordingly, effective preventive and therapeutic strategies are needed to address this persistent and growing threat.

Clinical manifestations range from mild febrile illness to severe disease with hemorrhage and death, and while vaccines are available, access remains limited. The article underscores the need for improved surveillance, integrated vector management, expanded vaccine access, and the development of effective therapies to mitigate the health, social, and economic impacts of dengue.

title: The Role of Temperature, Rainfall, and Humidity in Driving Dengue Virus Transmission in Urban Environments: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: This systematic literature review addresses critical limitations in climate-driven vector disease models, which currently rely on macro-level climatic or socioeconomic indicators—such as state-level Human Development Index scores—and fail to account for intra-urban microclimates, Urban Heat Island (UHI) effects, and localized human mobility. Furthermore, urban climate adaptation measures like engineered green infrastructure can inadvertently create thermal refuges and breeding sites for invasive vectors such as Aedes albopictus and Anopheles stephensi, while passive public health surveillance routinely omits asymptomatic disease transmission. To bridge these interdisciplinary gaps, the study aims to evaluate fine-scale intra-urban microclimatic and ecological drivers, synthesize high-resolution spatial-temporal and machine learning predictive forecasting models, and formulate a cross-sectoral urban health preparedness model that aligns urban planning with vector control. Focusing on human populations within urban environments in India, the review evaluates peer-reviewed journal articles published between 2017 and 2026. Literature is identified using the query string TITLE-ABS-KEY (("urban population") AND ("climate" OR "temperature" OR "rain" OR "humidity" OR "weather") AND ("dengue" OR "dengue virus")) AND PUBYEAR > 2016 AND PUBYEAR < 2027. The review specifically includes prospective observational cohort studies and high-resolution spatial-temporal modeling research that evaluate localized ambient or surface temperature, relative humidity, rainfall, green infrastructure, and sub-neighborhood disease incidence. Studies evaluating travel-imported cases, laboratory-controlled mosquitoes without human settlement data, spatially aggregated macro-level proxies, non-thermal climate variables in isolation, qualitative-only designs, or unvalidated software and poster documentation are excluded. Ultimately, this review synthesizes evidence on how localized microclimatic variations and green infrastructure influence vector ecology and dengue virus transmission. By integrating real-time serological surveillance, micro-environmental data, vector indices, and ensemble forecasting techniques, the framework advances beyond passive surveillance to provide actionable evidence for municipal urban planners and public health officials

title_zh: 温度、降雨量和湿度在城市环境中驾驶 登革病毒 传播 的作用:系统文献综述
source_body_en: This systematic literature review addresses critical limitations in climate-driven vector disease models, which currently rely on macro-level climatic or socioeconomic indicators—such as state-level Human Development Index scores—and fail to account for intra-urban microclimates, Urban Heat Island (UHI) effects, and localized human mobility. Furthermore, urban climate adaptation measures like engineered green infrastructure can inadvertently create thermal refuges and breeding sites for invasive vectors such as Aedes albopictus and Anopheles stephensi, while passive public health surveillance routinely omits asymptomatic disease transmission. To bridge these interdisciplinary gaps, the study aims to evaluate fine-scale intra-urban microclimatic and ecological drivers, synthesize high-resolution spatial-temporal and machine learning predictive forecasting models, and formulate a cross-sectoral urban health preparedness model that aligns urban planning with vector control. Focusing on human populations within urban environments in India, the review evaluates peer-reviewed journal articles published between 2017 and 2026. Literature is identified using the query string TITLE-ABS-KEY (("urban population") AND ("climate" OR "temperature" OR "rain" OR "humidity" OR "weather") AND ("dengue" OR "dengue virus")) AND PUBYEAR > 2016 AND PUBYEAR < 2027. The review specifically includes prospective observational cohort studies and high-resolution spatial-temporal modeling research that evaluate localized ambient or surface temperature, relative humidity, rainfall, green infrastructure, and sub-neighborhood disease incidence. Studies evaluating travel-imported cases, laboratory-controlled mosquitoes without human settlement data, spatially aggregated macro-level proxies, non-thermal climate variables in isolation, qualitative-only designs, or unvalidated software and poster documentation are excluded. Ultimately, this review synthesizes evidence on how localized microclimatic variations and green infrastructure influence vector ecology and dengue virus transmission. By integrating real-time serological surveillance, micro-environmental data, vector indices, and ensemble forecasting techniques, the framework advances beyond passive surveillance to provide actionable evidence for municipal urban planners and public health officials
abstract_zh: 这项系统文献综述探讨了气候驱动的登革热模型中的关键局限性,这些模型目前依赖于宏观层面的气候或社会经济指标——例如州级的人类发展指数(HDI)得分——而未能考虑城市内部的微气候、城市热岛(UHI)效应以及局部人类活动。此外,城市气候适应措施,如人工绿色基础设施,可能会无意中创造热避难所并为入侵性登革热媒介如埃及伊蚊(Aedes albopictus)和按蚊(Anopheles stephensi)提供繁殖场所,而被动公共卫生措施通常忽略无症状疾病的传播。为弥合这些跨学科的差距,本研究旨在评估城市内部微气候和生态驱动因素的精细尺度,综合高分辨率时空和机器学习预测性预报模型,并制定一个跨部门的城市健康准备模型,将城市规划与登革热控制相结合。本综述聚焦于印度城市环境中的人群,评估了2017年至2026年间发表的同行评审期刊文章。文献检索使用查询字符串 TITLE-ABS-KEY (("urban population") AND ("climate" OR "temperature" OR "rain" OR "humidity" OR "weather") AND ("dengue" OR "登革热")) AND PUBYEAR > 2016 AND PUBYEAR < 2027。综述特别包括前瞻性观察性研究和高分辨率时空建模研究,这些研究评估了局部环境或地表温度、相对湿度、降雨量、绿色基础设施以及次邻里范围内的疾病传播。排除了评估旅行输入病例、实验室控制的蚊虫(缺乏人类聚居地数据)、空间聚合的宏观层面代理变量、孤立的非热气候变量、仅定性设计或未经验证的软件和海报文档的研究。最终,本综述综合了证据,说明局部微气候变化和绿色基础设施如何影响登革热的生态和传播。通过整合实时血清学数据、微环境数据、登革热指数以及集成预测技术,该框架超越了被动公共卫生措施,为市政城市规划者和公共卫生官员提供可操作的证据

title: Risk factors associated with dengue fever outbreak in Harf Sufyan district-Amran governorate, Yemen, 2023: case control study
abstract: Dengue Fever (DF) is endemic in Yemen. On September 4th, 2023, the surveillance officer in Amran governorate reported an increased number of suspected DF in Harf-Sufyan district. On September 5th, 2023, a team from electronic Integrated Disease Early Warning System eIDEWS and Rapid Response (RR) program was sent to investigate. This study aimed to confirm the existence of the outbreak, determine risk factors, and recommend control measures. A descriptive case-control study (1:2 ratio) was conducted in Harf Sufyan from 5 September to 29 October 2023. The standard WHO case definition of DF was used to collect data from cases. Controls are any person living in the same area and his/her houses adjacent to the homes of cases without dengue fever. Data on individual, environmental, and behavioral risk factors were collected. Attack rates, odds ratios, and confidence intervals (CI) were calculated with p < 0.05 considered statistically significant. A total of 34 patients were positive for DF IgM, and 68 controls were included in this study. The males were 58% and 43% were < 30 years old of age. The overall attack rate was 0.9/100 of the population. The first case of DF was in the epi week 37 and reached the peak in week 39. Multivariate analysis revealed only wearing short (OR: 17, CI: 4.8–60.1) and T-shirts clothes and who working (OR: 23, CI: 2.9–33.2) were significant associated factors with DF infection. The findings highlight that the DF is emerging to be an important disease in in Harf Sufyan district-Amran governorate, Yemen. Occupational exposure and wearing short-sleeved clothing found to be the primary significant risk factors. Therefore, increasing community awareness about the DF infection, mode of transmission, and control measures, as well as protective clothes, is highly recommended.

title_zh: 2023 年也门阿姆兰省 Harf Sufyan 地区与 登革热 暴发 相关的危险因素:病例对照研究
source_body_en: Dengue Fever (DF) is endemic in Yemen. On September 4th, 2023, the surveillance officer in Amran governorate reported an increased number of suspected DF in Harf-Sufyan district. On September 5th, 2023, a team from electronic Integrated Disease Early Warning System eIDEWS and Rapid Response (RR) program was sent to investigate. This study aimed to confirm the existence of the outbreak, determine risk factors, and recommend control measures. A descriptive case-control study (1:2 ratio) was conducted in Harf Sufyan from 5 September to 29 October 2023. The standard WHO case definition of DF was used to collect data from cases. Controls are any person living in the same area and his/her houses adjacent to the homes of cases without dengue fever. Data on individual, environmental, and behavioral risk factors were collected. Attack rates, odds ratios, and confidence intervals (CI) were calculated with p < 0.05 considered statistically significant. A total of 34 patients were positive for DF IgM, and 68 controls were included in this study. The males were 58% and 43% were < 30 years old of age. The overall attack rate was 0.9/100 of the population. The first case of DF was in the epi week 37 and reached the peak in week 39. Multivariate analysis revealed only wearing short (OR: 17, CI: 4.8–60.1) and T-shirts clothes and who working (OR: 23, CI: 2.9–33.2) were significant associated factors with DF infection. The findings highlight that the DF is emerging to be an important disease in in Harf Sufyan district-Amran governorate, Yemen. Occupational exposure and wearing short-sleeved clothing found to be the primary significant risk factors. Therefore, increasing community awareness about the DF infection, mode of transmission, and control measures, as well as protective clothes, is highly recommended.

title: Temporal trends of dengue exposure among children in coastal Kenya
abstract: Abstract Background Serosurveys suggest widespread dengue virus (DENV) transmission in Africa but there is limited information on the temporal patterns of exposure. Methods Using repeated cross-sectional serosurvey data, we estimated the prevalence and incidence of DENV infections in coastal Kenya over 20 years (1998–2018). Stored sera ( n = 8025), collected annually from an open longitudinal cohort of 1834 children aged 15 years and below, were screened for anti-DENV IgG antibodies. Results We show that, of 8025 samples, 2287 (28.5%, 95% CI 27.5–29.5%) were seropositive for DENV IgG antibodies. Seroprevalence increased with age, from 2% among children aged below 1 year to 40% among those aged 9 to 10 years, and peaked during outbreak years. Among 1343 children who were seronegative at recruitment, the overall incidence (seroconversion) rate was 111.5 DENV infections per 1000 person-years (95% CI 102.5–121.2). The highest incidence occurred in 2013 at 439.7 infections per 1000 person-years (95% CI 375.1–515.5), coinciding with a large outbreak in coastal Kenya. Conclusions Our findings suggest long-term DENV exposure among children in coastal Kenya and highlight an urgent need for clinical surveillance to determine the associated health burden.

Stored sera ( n = 8025), collected annually from an open longitudinal cohort of 1834 children aged 15 years and below, were screened for anti-DENV IgG antibodies. Results We show that, of 8025 samples, 2287 (28.5%, 95% CI 27.5–29.5%) were seropositive for DENV IgG antibodies. Seroprevalence increased with age, from 2% among children aged below 1 year to 40% among those aged 9 to 10 years, and peaked during outbreak years. Among 1343 children who were seronegative at recruitment, the overall incidence (seroconversion) rate was 111.5 DENV infections per 1000 person-years (95% CI 102.5–121.2). The highest incidence occurred in 2013 at 439.7 infections per 1000 person-years (95% CI 375.1–515.5), coinciding with a large outbreak in coastal Kenya. Conclusions Our findings suggest long-term DENV exposure among children in coastal Kenya and highlight an urgent need for clinical surveillance to determine the associated health burden.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the temporal trends of dengue virus (DENV) exposure among children in coastal Kenya using repeated cross-sectional serosurvey data from 1998 to 2018. The research highlights the widespread prevalence of DENV infections, with seroprevalence increasing with age and peaking during outbreak years. The study found that 28.5% of 8025 samples were seropositive for DENV IgG antibodies, with the highest incidence recorded in 2013 at 439.7 infections per 1000 person-years. title: Identification and Expression Characterization of Leucine-Rich Repeat Proteins in Aedes albopictus in Response to Dengue Virus Infection
abstract: Mosquitoes transmit a wide range of human pathogens, including Plasmodium parasites and arboviruses. Insects rely primarily on pattern recognition receptors (PRRs) to initiate innate immunity against invading pathogens. Leucine-rich repeat proteins (LRRPs), such as LRIM1 and APL1, are critical PRRs that mediate anti- Plasmodium immunity in Anopheles mosquitoes. However, the roles of these proteins in Aedes albopictus, a major vector of dengue virus (DENV), remain poorly understood. In this study, we identified 49 LRRP-coding genes in the Ae. On the basis of LRR copy number and sequence features, these LRRPs were classified into five subfamilies: “Long” LRRPs, “Short” LRRPs, “TM” LRRPs, “Coil-less” LRRPs and “F-box” LRRPs. Phylogenetic and functional domain analysis revealed that the LRRPs of Ae. albopictus were highly conserved relative to their orthologs in other mosquito species. Expression profiling indicated that the LRIM1 and APL1A/B/C orthologs in Ae. albopictus display distinct expression patterns across developmental stages and in adult tissues. Furthermore, both blood feeding and DENV infection significantly modulated the transcriptional profiles of Ae. Collectively, our study provides a foundation for systematically exploring the functions of LRRPs during mosquito development, blood feeding, and innate immunity.

Collectively, our study provides a foundation for systematically exploring the functions of LRRPs during mosquito development, blood feeding, and innate immunity.

title: A tunable immune-evasion function of Zika virus NS5 governs viral fitness and pathogenesis.
abstract: Type I interferon (IFN) signaling is a central antiviral defense, with STAT2 driving the expression of IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) to restrict viral infection. Zika virus (ZIKV) and dengue virus evade this pathway through nonstructural protein 5 (NS5)-mediated ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of STAT2, yet the contribution of this immune-evasion strategy to viral fitness and pathogenesis remains incompletely defined. Here, using a multistep mutational scanning strategy that jointly assessed STAT2 degradation and viral RNA replication, we identified a single NS5 residue, L162, as uniquely permissive to substitution that abolishes STAT2 degradation without compromising intrinsic replication functions. Substitution of L162 with alanine or glycine (L162A or L162G) selectively disrupted NS5 recruitment of the ZSWIM8-CUL3 E3 ubiquitin ligase, thereby preserving STAT2 stability and restoring IFN signaling. Recombinant ZIKV carrying these mutations exhibited reduced replication and enhanced ISG induction in human cells, defects fully rescued by STAT2 knockout. In A129 mice (type I IFN receptor deficient), mutant and WT viruses replicated comparably, but in human STAT2 knock-in mice, ZIKV-NS5 L162G exhibited markedly reduced viral loads and disease. In pregnant human STAT2 knock-in mice, the mutant also reduced placental and fetal viral burdens and adverse pregnancy outcomes. Notably, infection with ZIKV-NS5 L162G elicited robust neutralizing antibody and T cell responses that conferred protection against WT challenge. Together, these findings establish NS5-mediated STAT2 degradation as a central determinant of ZIKV immune-evasion, viral fitness, and pathogenesis and highlight disruption of NS5–STAT2 antagonism as a promising strategy for antiviral intervention and rational attenuation.

Here, using a multistep mutational scanning strategy that jointly assessed STAT2 degradation and viral RNA replication, we identified a single NS5 residue, L162, as uniquely permissive to substitution that abolishes STAT2 degradation without compromising intrinsic replication functions. Substitution of L162 with alanine or glycine (L162A or L162G) selectively disrupted NS5 recruitment of the ZSWIM8-CUL3 E3 ubiquitin ligase, thereby preserving STAT2 stability and restoring IFN signaling. Recombinant ZIKV carrying these mutations exhibited reduced replication and enhanced ISG induction in human cells, defects fully rescued by STAT2 knockout. In A129 mice (type I IFN receptor deficient), mutant and WT viruses replicated comparably, but in human STAT2 knock-in mice, ZIKV-NS5L162G exhibited markedly reduced viral loads and disease. In pregnant human STAT2 knock-in mice, the mutant also reduced placental and fetal viral burdens and adverse pregnancy outcomes. Notably, infection with ZIKV-NS5L162G elicited robust neutralizing antibody and T cell responses that conferred protection against WT challenge. Together, these findings establish NS5-mediated STAT2 degradation as a central determinant of ZIKV immune-evasion, viral fitness, and pathogenesis and highlight disruption of NS5-STAT2 antagonism as a promising strategy for antiviral intervention and rational attenuation.

abstract_zh: I 型干扰素 (IFN) 信号传导是 抗病毒药物 防御的核心,STAT2 驱动 IFN 刺激基因 (ISG) 的表达以限制病毒感染。寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 和 登革病毒 通过非结构蛋白 5 (NS5) 介导的 STAT2 泛素化和蛋白酶体降解来逃避这一途径,但这种免疫逃避策略对病毒适应性和 发病机制 的贡献仍未完全确定。在这里,使用联合评估 STAT2 降解和病毒 RNA 复制的多步突变扫描策略,我们确定了一个 NS5 残基 L162,它唯一允许取代,从而消除 STAT2 降解而不损害内在的复制功能。用丙氨酸或甘氨酸(L162A 或 L162G)替代 L162 选择性破坏 ZSWIM8-CUL3 E3 泛素连接酶的 NS5 募集,从而保持 STAT2 稳定性并恢复 IFN 信号传导。携带这些 突变 的重组 ZIKV 在人类细胞中表现出复制减少和 ISG 诱导增强,这些缺陷可通过 STAT2 敲除完全修复。在 A129 小鼠(I 型 IFN 受体缺陷)中,突变病毒和 WT 病毒的复制情况相当,但在人 STAT2 敲入小鼠中,ZIKV-NS5 L162G 表现出病毒载量和疾病显着减少。在怀孕的人类 STAT2 敲入小鼠中,该突变体还减少了胎盘和胎儿的病毒负荷以及不良妊娠结局。值得注意的是,ZIKV-NS5 L162G 的感染引发了强大的中和抗体和 T 细胞反应,从而提供了针对 WT 攻击的保护。总之,这些发现证实 NS5 介导的 STAT2 降解是 ZIKV 免疫逃避、病毒适应度和 发病机制 的核心决定因素,并强调破坏 NS5-STAT2 拮抗作用是 抗病毒药物 干预和合理减弱的有前途的策略。

title: Spatial-temporal clustering and high-risk area identification of dengue in Thailand: a 20-year national analysis using space-time scan statistics
abstract: Abstract Dengue remains a major public health challenge in Thailand, with substantial geographic variation. This study analyzed national dengue surveillance data (2005–2024; 1,640,368 cases) across five consecutive 4-year intervals to identify spatial clustering patterns, detect space-time clusters, and characterize the evolution of high-risk areas. Province-level pooled incidence rates were assessed using Global Moran’s I, Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA), and SaTScan space-time scan statistics with discrete Poisson models. Global Moran’s I showed significant positive spatial autocorrelation in four periods (I = 0.211–0.473, p < 0.01) but not during 2017–2020 (I = 0.065, p = 0.190), indicating spatial fragmentation. LISA revealed a progressive decline in High-High cluster provinces from 11 to 2 and a geographic shift from Central-Eastern to Northern Thailand. SaTScan detected 13 statistically significant clusters; the most likely cluster occurred in Northern Thailand (2013–2016, relative risk = 2.33, p < 0.001). The cluster with the highest cumulative burden encompassed the Central-Western region (2009–2016, 149,010 cases). Dengue exhibits dynamically evolving geographic patterns, with Northern Thailand emerging as the primary high-risk area requiring priority intervention. These findings support geographically stratified control strategies.

title: Compound climate extremes predict dengue risk at operational lead times across Brazil
abstract: Brazil has one of the highest dengue burdens globally, with transmission influenced by climate events. Yet, the effects of compound climate extremes on dengue risk and prediction have not been quantified to date. Using a Bayesian spatiotemporal model of monthly dengue cases across 435 health regions from 2010 to 2025, we estimated relative risk associated with interacting long-lag and short-lag drought indicators and temperature anomalies across nine Köppen-Geiger climatic zones, adjusting for absolute temperature and El Niño-Southern Oscillation. Long-lag dry, mid-lag warm and short-lag wet conditions were associated with the highest relative risk in five climatic zones, with temperature anomalies modifying hydrometeorological dynamics more strongly in temperate than tropical areas. Climate covariates improved the prediction of case counts and outbreaks compared to baseline models at lead times of 1, 3, 6 and 12 months, and for the upcoming season 5 months ahead. Improvements were greatest in the Northeast, Southeast, and Midwest. Recent dengue incidence provided the greatest improvement at the 1-month lead, whereas combining incidence with climate information performed best at 3- and 6-month leads. We extended our framework to weekly state-level predictions of the season ahead to align with national public health planning. We proposed a multi-staged dengue forecasting approach to enhance early warning and response across Brazil.

Using a Bayesian spatiotemporal model of monthly dengue cases across 435 health regions from 2010 to 2025, we estimated relative risk associated with interacting long-lag and short-lag drought indicators and temperature anomalies across nine Köppen-Geiger climatic zones, adjusting for absolute temperature and El Niño-Southern Oscillation. Long-lag dry, mid-lag warm and short-lag wet conditions were associated with the highest relative risk in five climatic zones, with temperature anomalies modifying hydrometeorological dynamics more strongly in temperate than tropical areas. Climate covariates improved the prediction of case counts and outbreaks compared to baseline models at lead times of 1, 3, 6 and 12 months, and for the upcoming season 5 months ahead. Improvements were greatest in the Northeast, Southeast, and Midwest. Recent dengue incidence provided the greatest improvement at the 1-month lead, whereas combining incidence with climate information performed best at 3- and 6-month leads. We extended our framework to weekly state-level predictions of the season ahead to align with national public health planning. We proposed a multi-staged dengue forecasting approach to enhance early warning and response across Brazil.

abstract_zh: 巴西是全球登革热负担最高的国家之一,传播 受到气候事件的影响。然而,复合极端气候对登革热风险和预测的影响迄今为止尚未量化。利用 2010 年至 2025 年 435 个卫生区域每月登革热病例的贝叶斯时空模型,我们估计了九个柯本-盖革气候区的长滞后和短滞后干旱指标与温度异常相互作用的相对风险,并根据绝对温度和厄尔尼诺南方涛动进行了调整。长滞后干燥、中滞后温暖和短滞后潮湿条件与五个气候区的最高相对风险相关,温带地区的温度异常比热带地区对水文气象动态的影响更大。与提前期为 1、3、6 和 12 个月以及提前 5 个月即将到来的季节的基线模型相比,气候协变量改进了对病例数和 暴发 的预测。东北部、东南部和中西部地区的改善最为明显。最近的登革热 发病率 在 1 个月领先时提供了最大的改善,而将 发病率 与气候信息相结合在 3 个月和 6 个月领先时表现最佳。我们将框架扩展到对未来季节的每周州级预测,以与国家公共卫生规划保持一致。我们提出了多阶段登革热预报方法,以加强巴西各地的早期预警和应对。

title: Impact of urban heat islands on dengue thermal transmission suitability across contrasting U.S. cities
abstract: Ectotherms such as mosquitoes are exquisitely sensitive to environmental conditions, including temperature. Dengue fever, caused by dengue virus and transmitted by Aedes mosquitos, is commonly thought of as a tropical disease but has recently emerged in small local outbreaks in the USA. Urban heat island effects are a well-known phenomenon, but measuring their impact on air temperature at the scale of urban environments is complicated by the limitations of meteorological observations. These observations are collected only at discrete coordinates in which weather stations are located, making it difficult to interpret spatial variation across a landscape. Although global gridded reanalysis data such as ERA5 are available at hourly frequency, the finest spatial resolution is 0.25 ∘ , and thus the details in variation are lost. In this project, we developed a framework for localized machine learning models to predict the air temperature at a fine-scale 30 meter resolution for a given study area. The models we present are trained on location-specific satellite imagery and local weather station data, but we provide automated code for use with freely available data, allowing them to be retrained for nearly any location. In this study, we used these predictions to assess the seasonality of dengue thermal transmission suitability for Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus in two US cities. Urbanized areas were associated with extended projected dengue seasons for both vector species. This highlights the need for attention to urban planning and vector control in order to reduce the burden of arboviruses in dense urban areas.

source_records.abstract: Ectotherms such as mosquitoes are exquisitely sensitive to environmental conditions, including temperature. Dengue fever, caused by dengue virus and transmitted by Aedes mosquitos, is commonly thought of as a tropical disease but has recently emerged in small local outbreaks in the USA. Urban heat island effects are a well-known phenomenon, but measuring their impact on air temperature at the scale of urban environments is complicated by the limitations of meteorological observations. These observations are collected only at discrete coordinates in which weather stations are located, making it difficult to interpret spatial variation across a landscape. Although global gridded reanalysis data such as ERA5 are available at hourly frequency, the finest spatial resolution is 0.25 ∘ , and thus the details in variation are lost. In this project, we developed a framework for localized machine learning models to predict the air temperature at a fine-scale 30 meter resolution for a given study area. The models we present are trained on location-specific satellite imagery and local weather station data, but we provide automated code for use with freely available data, allowing them to be retrained for nearly any location. In this study, we used these predictions to assess the seasonality of dengue thermal transmission suitability for Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus in two US cities. Urbanized areas were associated with extended projected dengue seasons for both vector species. This highlights the need for attention to urban planning and vector control in order to reduce the burden of arboviruses in dense urban areas.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of urban heat islands on dengue thermal transmission suitability in two US cities. It highlights how urbanized areas may extend dengue seasons for both Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus. The research underscores the importance of urban planning and vector control in reducing the burden of arboviruses in dense urban areas. The study uses localized machine learning models to predict air temperature at a fine-scale resolution, trained on satellite imagery and weather station data. However, the spatial resolution of global reanalysis data limits the study's ability to capture detailed temperature variations. The findings suggest that urban heat islands may contribute to the persistence of dengue in non-tropical regions, offering insights for public health interventions.

abstract_zh: 蚊子等变温动物对环境条件(包括温度)非常敏感。登革热 是由 登革病毒 引起并由伊蚊传播的疾病,通常被认为是一种热带疾病,但最近在美国的小型局部 暴发 中出现。城市热岛效应是一种众所周知的现象,但由于气象观测的局限性,在城市环境范围内测量其对气温的影响变得复杂。这些观测结果仅在气象站所在的离散坐标处收集,因此很难解释整个景观的空间变化。尽管ERA5等全球网格化再分析数据可以每小时一次获得,但最精细的空间分辨率为0.25∘,因此丢失了变化的细节。在这个项目中,我们开发了一个本地化机器学习模型框架,能够以 30 米的精细分辨率预测给定研究区域的气温。我们提供的模型是根据特定位置的卫星图像和当地气象站数据进行训练的,但我们提供了与免费可用数据一起使用的自动化代码,使它们可以针对几乎任何位置进行重新训练。在本研究中,我们使用这些预测来评估登革热 传播 对埃及伊蚊和伊蚊的适宜性的季节性。白纹伊蚊分布在美国两个城市。城市化地区与 媒介 物种的预计登革热季节延长有关。这凸显了需要关注城市规划和 媒介 控制,以减轻密集城市地区虫媒病毒的负担。

title: Faktor-Faktor yang Berhubungan dengan Kejadian Demam Berdarah Dengue di Wilayah Kerja Puskesmas Ulee Kareng Kota Banda Aceh
abstract: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) remains a major public health challenge in tropical regions. Ulee Kareng Health Center recorded the highest number of DHF cases in Banda Aceh City, with a persistent surge reaching 49 cases in 2025. While prior studies evaluated environmental or behavioral factors in isolation, comprehensive evidence integrating domestic physical infrastructure and preventive behavior under individual matching designs remains limited. A quantitative observational study with a 1:1 matched case-control design was conducted from July 12–19, 2026. A total of 50 respondents (25 cases and 25 controls) were selected using total sampling for confirmed cases and neighborhood-matched controls based on age (±2 years) and sex. Bivariate relationships were evaluated using Chi-Square tests with Continuity Correction and Fisher's Exact Test to accommodate zero-cell counts in contingency tables. Significant associations were observed between DHF incidence and residential drainage condition (p=0.001), household waste management (p=0.001), and individual preventive actions (p=0.001; OR=3.778; 95% CI: 2.157–6.615). Conversely, clean water availability showed a borderline statistical value (p=0.050), which did not meet the strict statistical significance threshold (p<0.05). Conclusion: Inadequate home drainage, unsatisfactory waste management, and poor preventive actions significantly increase DHF transmission risk. Vector control interventions in Ulee Kareng must prioritize environmental sanitation and targeted community-based breeding site elimination (PSN 3M Plus).
journal: Journal of Educational Innovation and Public Health

analysis.main_results: Significant associations were observed between DHF incidence and residential drainage condition (p=0.001), household waste management (p=0.001), and individual preventive actions (p=0.001; OR=3.778; 95% CI: 2.157–6.615). Clean water availability showed a borderline statistical value (p=0.050), which did not meet the strict statistical significance threshold (p<0.05).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that inadequate home drainage, unsatisfactory waste management, and poor preventive actions significantly increase DHF transmission risk. Conducted as a 1:1 matched case-control study from July 12–19, 2026, it included 25 DHF cases and 25 neighborhood-matched controls. The results showed significant associations between DHF incidence and residential drainage conditions, household waste management, and individual preventive actions. Clean water availability had a borderline statistical value. The authors concluded that poor drainage, waste management, and preventive behaviors increase DHF transmission risk. The study highlights the need for environmental sanitation and community-based interventions to mitigate DHF. However, the findings are limited to a single health center and have moderate evidence strength due to the observational design and small sample size.

analysis_zh.methods: 使用带有连续性校正的卡方检验和费舍尔精确检验来评估双变量关系,以适应列联表中的零单元格计数。该研究的重点是评估住宅排水条件、家庭废物管理和个人预防措施。
analysis_zh.main_results: DHF 发病率 与住宅排水条件 (p=0.001)、家庭废物管理 (p=0.001) 和个人预防措施 (p=0.001;OR=3.778;95% CI: 2.157–6.615) 之间存在显着相关性。清洁水的可用性显示出临界统计值(p=0.050),未达到严格的统计显着性阈值(p<0.05)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,家庭排水不足、废物管理不善和预防措施不力会显着增加 DHF 传播 风险。这项研究通过在个人匹配设计下整合国内物理基础设施和预防行为,提供了新颖的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为 Ulee Kareng 的针对性 媒介 控制干预措施提供信息,强调环境卫生和社区繁殖地消除 (PSN 3M Plus) 对于降低 DHF 传播 风险的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于班达亚齐市的一个卫生中心,这可能会影响普遍性。由于观察设计和小样本量,证据强度中等。

title: Impacto epidemiológico del dengue y del chikungunya en zonas urbanas: revisión sistemática Epidemiological impact of dengue and chikungunya in urban areas: a systematic review
abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios. Resultados: la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013 y produjo brotes urbanos explosivos, con manifestaciones articulares persistentes. La urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus y la resistencia a insecticidas favorecieron la transmisión. Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado. Conclusión: ambas arbovirosis son una carga creciente para las ciudades tropicales y subtropicales y exigen vigilancia y control sostenidos.

analysis.scope_and_question: El objetivo de esta revisión sistemática fue sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. La revisión abarca Dengue viruses 1–4 y la enfermedad dengue, excluyendo otros flaviviruses como Zika, fiebre amarilla, virus del Nilo Occidental y virus de la encefalitis japonesa, a menos que se presenten evidencias específicas sobre el dengue.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: La revisión sistemática se realizó en PubMed y SciELO entre 2012 y 2025, incluyendo 15 estudios. Se utilizó una síntesis narrativa para resumir la evidencia, sin realizar meta-análisis estadísticos.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Los resultados muestran que la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y una alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013, causando brotes urbanos explosivos y manifestaciones articulares persistentes.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: La evidencia indica que la urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus, así como la resistencia a insecticidas, favorecen la transmisión de ambos virus. Sin embargo, no se reportan estudios que aborden de manera específica los mecanismos de transmisión o la variabilidad genética de los Dengue viruses 1–4 en contextos urbanos.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Se destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado para mitigar el impacto de la dengue. Se recomienda fortalecer la vigilancia epidemiológica y la implementación de medidas de control en áreas urbanas con alta prevalencia de los Dengue viruses 1–4.

analysis.summary_en: Esta revisión sistemática analiza el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya, enfocándose en Dengue viruses 1–4 y la enfermedad dengue. Se incluyeron 15 estudios obtenidos de PubMed y SciELO entre 2012 y 2025. Los resultados muestran un aumento global en la incidencia del dengue desde 1990, con una carga significativa en América Latina, y una expansión del chikungunya en las Américas desde 2013, causando brotes explosivos. Se identificaron factores como la urbanización, la presencia de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus, y la resistencia a insecticidas como promotores de la transmisión. Se destacan estrategias como las vacunas y el control vectorial integrado, y se recomienda una vigilancia epidemiológica más robusta en áreas urbanas afectadas.

abstract_zh: 目的:证明城市流行病学对登革热和基孔肯雅热的影响。方法:PubMed 和 SciELO 中的 síntesis narrativa 的修订(2012-2025);包括 15 个工作室。结果:1990 年世界登革热事件,拉丁美洲地区市场和货运方面存在差异。基孔肯雅热在 2013 年美洲地区得到扩展,并产生了城市爆炸性的产品,并具有持久的关节表现。城市化、埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊的扩张以及对传播有利于杀虫剂的抵抗力。Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado。结论:虫媒病毒在热带和亚热带城市中发挥着重要作用,并在预防和控制方面发挥着重要作用。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 我们对系统进行了修订,以证明登革热和基孔肯雅热对城市流行病的影响。修订版 登革病毒 1–4 和登革热,不包括寨卡病毒、黄病毒、西尼罗病毒和日本脑炎病毒,这是登革热特有的证据。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 2012 年至 2025 年 PubMed 和 SciELO 系统的修订,包括 15 个研究室。使用综合叙述来恢复证据,并实现元分析。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 1990 年世界登革热疫情的结果,与拉丁美洲地区市场和其他地区的差异有关。基孔肯雅热在 2013 年美洲地区扩展,导致城市爆炸和关节持续表现。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 有证据表明,城市化、埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊的扩张,有助于抵抗杀虫剂,有利于安博斯病毒的传播。但禁止对城市背景下的 登革病毒 1-4 遗传变量的传输机制进行特殊研究。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: Se destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado para mitigar el Impacto de la dengue.建议在 登革病毒 1-4 的城市地区进行流行病学警戒和医疗控制实施。

title: Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT) as a Predictor of Bleeding Manifestations and Severity in Adult Patients with Dengue – A Cross Sectional Study
abstract: Background: Dengue fever is a leading cause of acute febrile illness in tropical regions. Thrombocytopenia alone correlates poorly with bleeding in dengue. Activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) reflects intrinsic coagulation dysfunction and may serve as a superior predictor. Objectives: To assess deranged aPTT as a predictor of bleeding manifestations and to evaluate its association with severity of dengue in adult patients. Methods: Cross-sectional observational study at SVMCH & RC, Puducherry (January–March 2026). Forty adult patients with serologically confirmed dengue were enrolled. aPTT at admission was the primary exposure variable; patients were observed for bleeding and severe dengue (CDC 2015 criteria). Results: Twenty of the forty patients exhibited prolonged aPTT (mean 54.8 ± 9.3 s) and twenty had normal aPTT (mean 34.6 ± 2.9 s). Any bleeding (RR=3.25; p=0.026), substantial bleeding (RR=3.00; p=0.048), and severe dengue (RR=3.75; p=0.001) were all strongly correlated with prolonged aPTT. For significant bleeding, the negative predictive value (NPV) was 95.0%. There was no discernible relationship between platelet count and bleeding symptoms. Conclusion: aPTT is a reliable rule-out screening tool for major bleeding and severity in dengue, with an NPV of 95%. Platelet count alone is insufficient to predict bleeding risk.
journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study investigated the utility of activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) as a predictor of bleeding manifestations and severity in adult dengue patients. The study was conducted at SVMCH & RC, Puducherry, between January and March 2026, involving forty serologically confirmed dengue cases. aPTT was measured at admission, and patients were observed for bleeding and severe dengue based on CDC 2015 criteria. Results showed that prolonged aPTT was strongly associated with any bleeding, substantial bleeding, and severe dengue, with a negative predictive value of 95% for significant bleeding. The study's limitations include its single-center design and small sample size, but the evidence is strong due to the clear statistical associations observed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 是热带地区急性发热性疾病的主要原因。单独的血小板减少症与登革热出血的相关性较差。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在本地治里 SVMCH & RC 进行的横断面观察研究(2026 年 1 月至 3 月)。四十名经血清学证实患有登革热的成年患者被纳入研究。
elements_zh.methods: 入院时的 aPTT 是主要暴露变量;观察患者的出血情况和 重症登革热(CDC 2015 标准)。
elements_zh.main_results: 40 名患者中,20 名患者的 aPTT 延长(平均 54.8 ± 9.3 秒),20 名患者的 aPTT 正常(平均 34.6 ± 2.9 秒)。任何出血(RR=3.25;p=0.026)、大量出血(RR=3.00;p=0.048)和重症登革热(RR=3.75;p=0.001)均与aPTT延长密切相关。血小板计数和出血症状之间没有明显的关系。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: aPTT 是一种可靠的排除登革热大出血和严重程度的筛查工具,NPV 为 95%。仅血小板计数不足以预测出血风险。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,aPTT 可用作筛查工具,以识别有大出血和 重症登革热 风险的患者,从而有可能改善临床决策。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单个中心和小样本量,但由于报告的明确的统计关联,证据是强有力的。

Results: Twenty of the forty patients exhibited prolonged aPTT (mean 54.8 ± 9.3 s) and twenty had normal aPTT (mean 34.6 ± 2.9 s). Any bleeding (RR=3.25; p=0.026), substantial bleeding (RR=3.00; p=0.048), and severe dengue (RR=3.75; p=0.001) were all strongly correlated with prolonged aPTT. For significant bleeding, the negative predictive value (NPV) was 95.0%. There was no discernible relationship between platelet count and bleeding symptoms. Conclusion: aPTT is a reliable rule-out screening tool for major bleeding and severity in dengue, with an NPV of 95%. Platelet count alone is insufficient to predict bleeding risk.

title: Nanotechnology-Enabled Vaccines for Malaria, Tuberculosis, HIV, and Dengue: Translational Evidence and Implementation in the Global South
abstract: Nanoscale materials can support vaccine delivery, antigen display and immune stimulation, but successful platform function or enhanced immunogenicity does not necessarily establish meaningful or durable clinical protection. This narrative review examines evidence published from January 2016 through April 2026, with selected foundational studies, for nanotechnology-enabled vaccines against malaria, tuberculosis, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and dengue, focusing on their relevance to the Global South. These diseases were selected for their substantial public-health burden, distinct biological barriers to vaccination and contrasting stages of translational development, enabling comparison across preclinical research, human immunogenicity, clinical efficacy and implementation evidence. The synthesis distinguishes the functional contribution of nanoscale carriers, antigen-display scaffolds and adjuvants from the performance of complete vaccine formulations. Malaria has the most advanced clinical and implementation evidence among the reviewed platforms. Tuberculosis has disease-prevention evidence in a defined infected adult population, and HIV and dengue platforms remain predominantly at preclinical or early clinical stages. Clinical efficacy of a nano-enabled formulation does not, by itself, quantify the incremental benefit attributable to its nanoscale component. Across diseases, translational value depends on antigen suitability, disease-relevant immune function, durability, formulation-specific safety and applicability to the intended population. Evidence from selected trial cohorts cannot automatically be generalized across heterogeneous Global South settings. Manufacturing readiness, storage requirements, affordable complete schedules, regulatory capacity and equitable access must therefore be assessed alongside biological performance. The review identifies where links between platform function, clinical benefit and feasible implementation are supported and where they remain unestablished.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on nanotechnology-enabled vaccines for dengue virus, specifically examining their translational evidence and implementation potential in the Global South. The central question is whether these vaccines can provide meaningful and durable clinical protection against dengue, considering the unique biological and public health challenges associated with the disease.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of evidence published from January 2016 through April 2026, with selected foundational studies. It does not report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates but instead provides a qualitative overview of the evidence, emphasizing the functional contributions of nanoscale carriers, antigen-display scaffolds, and adjuvants in vaccine formulations.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that dengue has the most advanced clinical and implementation evidence among the reviewed platforms. It highlights that the clinical efficacy of a nano-enabled formulation does not automatically quantify the incremental benefit from its nanoscale component, and that translational value depends on factors such as antigen suitability, immune function, durability, and formulation-specific safety.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is evidence that the performance of complete vaccine formulations cannot be solely attributed to their nanoscale components. Additionally, the review notes that evidence from selected trial cohorts may not be generalizable across all Global South settings due to heterogeneity. The review also identifies gaps in understanding the links between platform function, clinical benefit, and feasible implementation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need to assess manufacturing readiness, storage requirements, affordable complete schedules, regulatory capacity, and equitable access alongside biological performance. It also suggests that further research is required to establish the incremental benefits of nanoscale components in vaccine formulations and to improve generalizability across diverse populations in the Global South.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates nanotechnology-enabled vaccines for dengue virus, focusing on their translational potential and implementation in the Global South. It also identifies gaps in generalizability across diverse populations and calls for further research to improve vaccine performance and accessibility.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注纳米技术支持的 疫苗 for 登革病毒,特别检查其在全球南方的转化证据和实施潜力。核心问题是,考虑到与该疾病相关的独特的生物学和公共卫生挑战,这些 疫苗 是否能够提供有意义且持久的针对登革热的临床保护。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论是对 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月期间发表的证据的叙述性综合,其中包括选定的基础研究。它不报告荟萃分析或汇总估计,而是提供证据的定性概述,强调 疫苗 制剂中纳米级载体、抗原展示支架和佐剂的功能贡献。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,登革热在审查的平台中拥有最先进的临床和实施证据。它强调,纳米制剂的临床功效不会自动量化其纳米级成分的增量益处,并且转化价值取决于抗原适用性、免疫功能、耐久性和制剂特定安全性等因素。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 有证据表明,完整的 疫苗 配方的性能不能仅仅归因于其纳米级成分。此外,审查指出,由于异质性,选定试验 队列研究 的证据可能无法推广到所有南半球国家。该审查还确定了在理解平台功能、临床效益和可行实施之间的联系方面的差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要评估生产准备情况、存储要求、负担得起的完整时间表、监管能力以及公平获取和生物性能。它还表明需要进一步研究来确定 疫苗 配方中纳米级成分的增量效益,并提高全球南方不同人群的普遍适用性。

abstract_zh: 纳米级材料可以支持 疫苗 递送、抗原展示和免疫刺激,但成功的平台功能或增强的免疫原性并不一定能建立有意义或持久的临床保护。这篇叙述性综述审查了 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月发表的证据,以及选定的基础研究,用于纳米技术支持的 疫苗 对抗疟疾、结核病、人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 和登革热,重点关注它们与全球南方的相关性。选择这些疾病是因为其巨大的公共卫生负担、疫苗接种 的独特生物障碍以及转化发展的对比阶段,从而能够在临床前研究、人类免疫原性、临床疗效和实施证据之间进行比较。该合成将纳米级载体、抗原展示支架和佐剂的功能贡献与完整 疫苗 制剂的性能区分开来。Malaria 在已审查的平台中拥有最先进的临床和实施证据。结核病在确定的感染成年人群中具有疾病预防证据,而艾滋病毒和登革热平台仍主要处于临床前或早期临床阶段。纳米制剂的临床功效本身并不能量化归因于其纳米级成分的增量益处。在疾病中,转化价值取决于抗原的适用性、疾病相关的免疫功能、耐久性、制剂特异性的安全性以及对目标人群的适用性。来自选定试验 队列研究 的证据不能自动推广到异构的全球南方环境中。因此,必须与生物性能一起评估生产准备情况、储存要求、负担得起的完整时间表、监管能力和公平获取。该审查确定了平台功能、临床效益和可行实施之间的联系在哪些方面得到了支持,哪些方面尚未建立。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注纳米技术支持的 疫苗 for 登革病毒,特别检查其在全球南方的转化证据和实施潜力。核心问题是,考虑到与该疾病相关的独特的生物学和公共卫生挑战,这些 疫苗 是否能够提供有意义且持久的针对登革热的临床保护。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论是对 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月期间发表的证据的叙述性综合,其中包括选定的基础研究。它不报告荟萃分析或汇总估计,而是提供证据的定性概述,强调 疫苗 制剂中纳米级载体、抗原展示支架和佐剂的功能贡献。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,登革热在审查的平台中拥有最先进的临床和实施证据。它强调,纳米制剂的临床功效不会自动量化其纳米级成分的增量益处,并且转化价值取决于抗原适用性、免疫功能、耐久性和制剂特定安全性等因素。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 有证据表明,完整的 疫苗 配方的性能不能仅仅归因于其纳米级成分。此外,审查指出,由于异质性,选定试验 队列研究 的证据可能无法推广到所有南半球国家。该审查还确定了在理解平台功能、临床效益和可行实施之间的联系方面的差距。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要评估生产准备情况、存储要求、负担得起的完整时间表、监管能力以及公平获取和生物性能。它还表明需要进一步研究来确定 疫苗 配方中纳米级成分的增量效益,并提高全球南方不同人群的普遍适用性。

title: Dengue Fever Prevention Education For Communities At Mangkupalas Health Center
abstract: Dengue remains a significant public health challenge within the operational area of Puskesmas Mangkupalas, while the baseline knowledge of community members regarding its prevention remains inadequate. This community service activity aims to enhance public awareness concerning vector control through mosquito nest eradication via draining, covering, recycling used items, and supplementary preventive measures. The educational program was conducted on May 23, 2026, engaging 20 participants through interactive lectures, discussions, question-and-answer sessions, and leaflets. Knowledge levels were assessed using a 10-item questionnaire administered before and immediately after the intervention. The average score increased from 6,40 to 9,45. Participants classified under the good knowledge category rose from 4 individuals (20%) to 18 individuals (90%), whereas those in the poor category decreased from 16 individuals (80%) to 2 individuals (10%). The Wilcoxon signed-rank test confirmed a significant difference in scores before and after the education session (Z = -3,871; p = 0,001). These findings indicate a short-term improvement in knowledge following the educational intervention, while continued monitoring remains necessary to evaluate the practical application of preventive behaviors within households

title: Travel Health Preparation Booklet on Malaria and Dengue for International Students Visiting Endemic Regions
abstract: This booklet is an educational travel health resource developed for international students traveling to malaria- and dengue-endemic regions, with Indonesia as the primary context. It provides information on disease characteristics, transmission, symptoms, diagnosis, prevention, treatment, vaccines, mosquito-bite prevention, and practical travel preparation. The booklet underwent expert content validation and target-user evaluation. It is intended as a supplementary educational resource and does not replace professional medical advice or individualized pre-travel consultation.

title: Bukti Terkini Pencegahan dan Penatalaksanaan Dengue pada Pasien Dewasa
abstract: Infeksi virus dengue (DENV) merupakan arbovirosis dengan laju penyebaran tercepat di dunia dan beban yang terus meningkat di Indonesia. Tahun 2024 tercatat sebagai tahun dengan jumlah kasus tertinggi yang pernah dilaporkan kepada Badan Kesehatan Dunia (WHO), dan Indonesia menempati posisi kedua terbesar di dunia. Dalam dua tahun terakhir, lanskap tata laksana dan pencegahan dengue berubah secara substansial: WHO menerbitkan pedoman klinis berbasis GRADE untuk penyakit arboviral pada Juli 2025, vaksin tetravalen TAK-003 memperoleh rekomendasi WHO dan data efektivitas dunia nyata pertamanya, vaksin dosis tunggal Butantan-DV melaporkan hasil fase 3, sementara kandidat antivirus spesifik pertama memasuki dan sebagian dihentikan pada uji klinis fase 2. Tinjauan pustaka ini merangkum bukti terkini mengenai epidemiologi, patogenesis, diagnosis, pencegahan, dan penatalaksanaan infeksi dengue dengan penekanan pada pasien dewasa serta konteks endemis Indonesia. Diagnosis awal berfokus pada pemilihan pemeriksaan yang sesuai dengan hari sakit; meta-analisis terbaru menunjukkan sensitivitas enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) antigen nonstruktural 1 (NS1) sebanding dengan reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) pada fase awal. Pencegahan bergeser dari pengendalian vektor berbasis insektisida, yang efektivitasnya menurun karena terjadinya resistensi, menuju pendekatan biologis Wolbachia dan vaksinasi. Penatalaksanaan tetap bersifat suportif dengan terapi utama yaitu resusitasi cairan kristaloid; WHO 2025 secara eksplisit menyarankan tidak menggunakan kortikosteroid sistemik maupun transfusi trombosit profilaksis, dan merekomendasikan kadar laktat serta waktu pengisian kapiler sebagai pemandu terapi cairan. Keterbatasan saat ini adalah ketiadaan terapi antivirus spesifik, keterbatasan data efikasi vaksin terhadap serotipe DENV-3 dan DENV-4 pada individu seronegatif, serta minimnya uji acak terkendali pada populasi dewasa.
authors: I Gusti Sri Agung Jaya Kusumadewi

analysis.summary_en: This study provides an updated review of the epidemiology, pathogenesis, diagnosis, prevention, and management of dengue infection, with a focus on adult patients in an endemic context. It highlights the shift from insecticide-based vector control to biological approaches like Wolbachia and vaccination, emphasizing the need for improved antiviral therapies and more controlled trials. The review underscores the importance of early diagnosis using NS1 ELISA and RT-PCR, and outlines the current limitations in treatment and vaccine efficacy, particularly against DENV-3 and DENV-4. The findings suggest that supportive care, including fluid resuscitation guided by lactate levels and capillary refill time, remains the mainstay of management. The study contributes to the understanding of dengue in Indonesia and informs future research directions.
